cli mock: `function cliMock(handlers) { return function(args) { calls.push(args.command); var h = handlers[args.command]; if (h) return h; throw new Error('unexpected command: ' + args.command); }; }`

For publishExistingBranch tests, revParse('HEAD') etc. are command-based: 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'git rev-parse origin/test/X', 'git merge-base HEAD origin/test/X'.

Sequence for publishExistingBranch(branch, wd):
1. `git fetch origin <branch>`
2. `git rev-parse HEAD` → localSha
3. `git rev-parse origin/<branch>` → remoteSha
4. if equal → return early
5. `git merge-base HEAD origin/<branch>` → mergeBase
6. branches...

Case local==remote: commands 1-3 only.

Case ahead: mergeBase === remoteSha → `git push -u origin <branch>`.

Case behind: mergeBase === localSha → `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`.

Case diverged: mergeBase differs from both → push → if throws, push --force-with-lease. To simulate push failure then lease success, handler throws on first 'git push -u origin b', returns '' second time. Use counter.

Case both fail: both throw → {success:false, error contains 'could not be pushed'}.

performGitOperations staged path:
- 'git status --short -- testing' → '' or some output (logged only)
- 'git add testing/'
- 'git diff --cached --stat' → non-empty → staged
- 'git commit -m "..."'
- 'git fetch origin <branch>'
- 'git push -u origin <branch>'
- 'git ls-remote --heads origin <branch>' → ref line. Note: real prHelper.remoteBranchExists is used by results module but in shared's performGitOperations the code calls prHelper.remoteBranchExists(runInRepo, workingDir, branchName) — injected prHelper. My fake: remoteBranchExists: function(run, wd, branch) { return run('git ls-remote --heads origin ' + branch, wd).indexOf('refs/heads') !== -1; } — mimic real behavior.

Also empty staged path: 'git diff --cached --stat' → '' → no staged changes → remoteBranchExists false → 'git push -u origin b' → return success, noNewCommit. remoteBranchExists true → publishExistingBranch.

For commit failure: 'git commit -m ...' throws → caught → {success:false}.

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

**Architecture**: extract pure helpers from both modules into a shared module `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` (new file) — or two separate helper modules? The ticket says "Extract shared/pure helpers". Two modules have different concerns:

- `postStoryTestAutomationResults.js`: result JSON reading, resume logic, markdown→Jira wiki, git ops (performGitOperations, publishExistingBranch, fetchRemoteBranch, revParse, findMergeBase), PR creation, TC status updates, label cleanup.
- `postStoryTestAutomationReview.js`: PR number resolution, diff-based inline comment filtering/posting, general comment, thread resolution, merge/rework triggers, label cleanup.

Shared between both: the tracker lazy-init pattern (initTracker/getTracker), removeAutomationLabels-ish (different though). Extracting a shared module with the tracker context could be one shared helper.

Key design decision: create `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` housing:
1. Tracker lazy-init (createTrackerContext) — used by both.
2. `readAttempt`/`writeAttempt`? Only used in results.
3. `markdownToJiraWiki` — pure, used in results.
4. Diff inline-comment helpers — those delegate to prReviewComments, used in review module only.

Hmm, but maybe simpler and lower-risk: create TWO new modules following the existing codebase pattern (like `postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js` exists! — check `js/unit-tests/test_postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js` and whether there's `js/common/postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js`). The pattern in this codebase: `js/common/*Helpers.js` or `js/postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js`. Let me check.

Plan:
- New file `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` with shared pure helpers + tests `js/unit-tests/test_storyTestAutomationShared.js`, registered in run_all.json.
- Refactor both modules to use it, keeping `action()` as the thin orchestrator.

But wait — the refactor must not break the existing tests, which load modules via loadModule with makeRequire maps. When I change `js/postStoryTestAutomationResults.js` to require the new shared module, the existing tests' makeRequire must provide it. blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

**Architecture**: extract pure helpers from both modules into a shared module `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` (new file) — or two separate helper modules? The ticket says "Extract shared/pure helpers". Two modules have different concerns:

- `postStoryTestAutomationResults.js`: result JSON reading, resume logic, markdown→Jira wiki, git ops (performGitOperations, publishExistingBranch, fetchRemoteBranch, revParse, findMergeBase), PR creation, TC status updates, label cleanup.
- `postStoryTestAutomationReview.js`: PR number resolution, diff-based inline comment filtering/posting, general comment, thread resolution, merge/rework triggers, label cleanup.

Shared between both: the tracker lazy-init pattern (initTracker/getTracker), removeAutomationLabels-ish (different though). Extracting a shared module with the tracker context could be one shared helper.

Key design decision: create `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` housing:
1. Tracker lazy-init (createTrackerContext) — used by both.
2. `readAttempt`/`writeAttempt`? Only used in results.
3. `markdownToJiraWiki` — pure, used in results.
4. Diff inline-comment helpers — those delegate to prReviewComments, used in review module only.

Hmm, but maybe simpler and lower-risk: create TWO new modules following the existing codebase pattern (like `postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js` exists! — check `js/unit-tests/test_postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js` and whether there's `js/common/postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js`). The pattern in this codebase: `js/common/*Helpers.js` or `js/postTestAutomationResultsHelpers.js`. Let me check.

Plan:
- New file `js/common/storyTestAutomationShared.js` with shared pure helpers + tests `js/unit-tests/test_storyTestAutomationShared.js`, registered in run_all.json.
- Refactor both modules to use it, keeping `action()` as the thin orchestrator.

But wait — the refactor must not break the existing tests, which load modules via loadModule with makeRequire maps. When I change `js/postStoryTestAutomationResults.js` to require the new shared module, the existing tests' makeRequire must provide it. blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

For publishExistingBranch tests, revParse('HEAD') etc. are command-based: 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'git rev-parse origin/test/X', 'git merge-base HEAD origin/test/X'.

Sequence for publishExistingBranch(branch, wd):
1. `git fetch origin <branch>`
2. `git rev-parse HEAD` → localSha
3. `git rev-parse origin/<branch>` → remoteSha
4. if equal → return early
5. `git merge-base HEAD origin/<branch>` → mergeBase
6. branches...

Case local==remote: commands 1-3 only.

Case ahead: mergeBase === remoteSha → `git push -u origin <branch>`.

Case behind: mergeBase === localSha → `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`.

Case diverged: mergeBase differs from both → push → if throws, push --force-with-lease. To simulate push failure then lease success, handler throws on first 'git push -u origin b', returns '' second time. Use counter.

Case both fail: both throw → {success:false, error contains 'could not be pushed'}.

performGitOperations staged path:
- 'git status --short -- testing' → '' or some output (logged only)
- 'git add testing/'
- 'git diff --cached --stat' → non-empty → staged
- 'git commit -m "..."'
- 'git fetch origin <branch>'
- 'git push -u origin <branch>'
- 'git ls-remote --heads origin <branch>' → ref line. blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

For publishExistingBranch tests, revParse('HEAD') etc. are command-based: 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'git rev-parse origin/test/X', 'git merge-base HEAD origin/test/X'.

Sequence for publishExistingBranch(branch, wd):
1. `git fetch origin <branch>`
2. `git rev-parse HEAD` → localSha
3. `git rev-parse origin/<branch>` → remoteSha
4. if equal → return early
5. `git merge-base HEAD origin/<branch>` → mergeBase
6. branches...

Case local==remote: commands 1-3 only.

Case ahead: mergeBase === remoteSha → `git push -u origin <branch>`.

Case behind: mergeBase === localSha → `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`.

Case diverged: mergeBase differs from both → push → if throws, push --force-with-lease. To simulate push failure then lease success, handler throws on first 'git push -u origin b', returns '' second time. Use counter.

Case both fail: both throw → {success:false, error contains 'could not be pushed'}.

performGitOperations staged path:
- 'git status --short -- testing' → '' or some output (logged only)
- 'git add testing/'
- 'git diff --cached --stat' → non-empty → staged
- 'git commit -m "..."'
- 'git fetch origin <branch>'
- 'git push -u origin <branch>'
- 'git ls-remote --heads origin <branch>' → ref line. blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

For publishExistingBranch tests, revParse('HEAD') etc. are command-based: 'git rev-parse HEAD', 'git rev-parse origin/test/X', 'git merge-base HEAD origin/test/X'.

Sequence for publishExistingBranch(branch, wd):
1. `git fetch origin <branch>`
2. `git rev-parse HEAD` → localSha
3. `git rev-parse origin/<branch>` → remoteSha
4. if equal → return early
5. `git merge-base HEAD origin/<branch>` → mergeBase
6. branches...

Case local==remote: commands 1-3 only.

Case ahead: mergeBase === remoteSha → `git push -u origin <branch>`.

Case behind: mergeBase === localSha → `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`.

Case diverged: mergeBase differs from both → push → if throws, push --force-with-lease. To simulate push failure then lease success, handler throws on first 'git push -u origin b', returns '' second time. Use counter.

Case both fail: both throw → {success:false, error contains 'could not be pushed'}.

- 'git status --short -- testing' → '' or some output (logged only)
- 'git add testing/'
- 'git diff --cached --stat' → non-empty → staged
- 'git commit -m "..."'
- 'git fetch origin <branch>'
- 'git push -u origin <branch>'
- 'git ls-remote --heads origin <branch>' → ref line. Also empty staged path: 'git diff --cached --stat' → '' → no staged changes → remoteBranchExists false → 'git push -u origin b' → return success, noNewCommit. remoteBranchExists true → publishExistingBranch.

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

1. `scm.calls.diffs[42] = SIMPLE_DIFF` — `calls.diffs` is `{}` but the error "Cannot set properties of undefined (setting '42')" — because `scm.calls` — wait, I set `scm.calls = calls` after defining scm object. Hmm, `scm.calls.diffs[42]` — calls.diffs exists = {}. Setting property 42 should work... unless scm.calls is undefined? I attach `scm.calls = calls` — yes I do. Wait the error occurs in postInlineComment tests where I do `scm.diffs[42] = SIMPLE_DIFF;` — NO! In the scmRecorder, the diff map is `calls.diffs`, and scm has `getPrDiff` closure reading `calls.diffs`. But in tests I wrote `scm.diffs[42] = SIMPLE_DIFF` — scm has no `diffs` property → `scm.diffs` undefined → error. In the diff-filtering suite I correctly used `scm.diffs[42]`... no wait, there I also used `scm.diffs[42] = SIMPLE_DIFF`. Hmm, let me check: in 'filterInlineCommentsByDiff keeps in-diff...' I wrote `scm.diffs[42] = SIMPLE_DIFF;`. And in scmRecorder, getPrDiff reads `calls.diffs`. So scm.diffs is undefined → should have failed there too. But only postInlineComment tests failed with that error... the filter tests may have failed differently. Let me fix scmRecorder: expose difs on both — simplest: in scmRecorder use `calls.diffs` and in tests set `scm.calls.diffs[42]`. Let me just add `scm.diffs = calls.diffs` — but getPrDiff already closes over calls.diffs, so setting scm.diffs[42] = X mutates the same object. Add that line.

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

blocks.text:
- name: Run the unit suite for coverage (instrumented tree)
        # Canonical green-gate is the dmtools-java runner (pack-release test job); the node
        # harness mirrors it (file_*/cli_*/assert/network-guard parity) and must be green too,
        # so a red harness fails this job instead of being swallowed. ci/run_with_coverage.js
        # wraps the harness and dumps the Istanbul global after the run.
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst"
          FILES="$(node -e "console.log(require('./js/unit-tests/run_all.json').params.jobParams.testFiles.join(' '))")"
          node ci/run_with_coverage.js \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/inst/js/unit-tests/node_testRunner.js" \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" $FILES

      - name: Fetch the released baseline
        id: baseline
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          if gh release download "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --pattern "$BASELINE_ASSET" \
               --dir "$RUNNER_TEMP/base" --clobber 2>/dev/null && [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" ]; then
            echo "present=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "baseline: $(node -e "const b=require('$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")"
          else
            echo "present=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "::notice::no $BASELINE_TAG release asset yet — bootstrapping from this run"
          fi

      - name: crap4js ratchet (compare with the released baseline)
        id: ratchet
        if: steps.baseline.outputs.present == 'true'
        run: |
          set +e
          # Redirect to a file (never a pipe): the report is ~500 KB and the verdict block comes last.
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js" . \
            --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" \
            --threshold "${CRAP_THRESHOLD}" \
            --baseline "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          code=$?
          head -30 "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"
          sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          if grep -q '^improved ' "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap.txt"; then echo "improved=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"; fi
          exit $code

      - name: Update the released baseline (main only — ratchets down, never up)
        if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' && (steps.ratchet.outcome == 'success' || steps.baseline.outputs.present != 'true')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -e
          CRAP="$RUNNER_TEMP/tools/node_modules/.bin/crap4js"
          NOTES="Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release. Measured at main@${GITHUB_SHA}"
          OUT="$RUNNER_TEMP/baseline-out/$BASELINE_ASSET"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$OUT")"
          # Full report (every function) for the README badges; ratchet steps keep their own outputs.
          "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold 99999 > "$RUNNER_TEMP/crap-all.txt" || true
          if [ "${{ steps.baseline.outputs.present }}" = "true" ]; then
            cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET" "$OUT"
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --update-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
            sed -n '/^CRAP Ratchet/,$p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            if cmp -s "$OUT" "$RUNNER_TEMP/base/$BASELINE_ASSET"; then
              echo "baseline unchanged — nothing to upload (marker refreshed)"
              gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
              exit 0
            fi
          else
            "$CRAP" . --coverage "$RUNNER_TEMP/cov/coverage-final.json" --threshold "$CRAP_THRESHOLD" \
              --baseline "$OUT" --write-baseline > "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          fi
          tail -1 "$RUNNER_TEMP/update.txt"
          if gh release view "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --clobber
          else
            gh release create "$BASELINE_TAG" "$OUT" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --prerelease --latest=false \
              --title "CRAP baseline (rolling)" \
              --notes "Rolling per-function CRAP baseline used by the Quality workflow. Updated after every merge to main; not a product release."
          fi
          # Marker the 'gate' job reads to skip runs when the baseline already covers main's HEAD.
          gh release edit "$BASELINE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --notes "$NOTES"
          echo "baseline released: $(node -e "const b=require('$OUT');console.log(Object.keys(b.functions).length+' functions, max '+b.maxCrap)")" | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

Sequence for publishExistingBranch(branch, wd):

6. branches...

Case behind: mergeBase === localSha → `git reset --hard origin/<branch>`.
